This chemical unit is engaged in the production of Caustic Soda, Hydrogen Peroxide, Hydrochloric Acid and Liquid Chlorine etc. We are currently looking for a highly experienced petrochemical professional to lead the operations, stabilization, and performance optimization of chemicals like PVC, VCM and other associated chemicals. Participate in process safety initiatives, including HAZOP studies and risk assessments, ensuring compliance with plant safety procedures, environmental regulations, and operational standards. Review P&ID, PFD, and process documentation, and contribute to equipment inspections and operational readiness of vessels, pipelines, and process units.
